description: A new theoretical study suggests dark matter may not exist, proposing instead that gravity behaves differently across vast cosmic distances. By modifying how gravity weakens over scale, the research explains galaxy rotation and lensing effects without unseen particles, raising questions about long-standing cosmological models and inviting a fresh look at gravity’s hidden complexity.
title: Dark Matter May Not Exist, Study Suggests Gravity Works Differently at Cosmic Scales

description: Apple has opened applications for its annual Swift Student Challenge, a global competition for students who want to become developers. The Apple Swift Student Challenge 2026 application window will remain open till February 28, and interested individuals can apply for the same. The competition requires participants to develop an app that addresses one or more issues in their community and beyond, using tools provided by the tech giant.
title: Apple Opens Applications for Swift Student Challenge 2026: Know Dates, Eligibility, Rewards

description: This feature lists five gaming earbuds available in India under Rs. 5,000, including the Spigen Audio SA-TW P20, Boat Nirvana Crown, CrossBeats Fury Max, OnePlus Nord Buds 3r, and GoBoult Astra Neo. These earbuds offer gaming-focused low-latency modes along with features like active noise cancellation, large dynamic drivers, and ENC microphones for clearer calls. Most models also include fast charging, Bluetooth connectivity, and claimed long battery life, making them useful for gaming and daily listening.
title: Best Gaming Earbuds Under Rs 5,000 in India: Boat Nirvana Crown, CrossBeats Fury Max, and More

description: Here’s a list of some of the best smartphones available in India that use silicon-carbon battery technology. This new battery technology offers higher energy density and faster charging than traditional Li-ion batteries. These battery units tend to heat less and can support more charge cycles over time. The list of best phones in India with silicon-carbon battery includes the OnePlus 15, Redmi Note 14 Pro+, Motorola Signature, iQOO 15 and Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G.
title: Best Smartphones in India With Silicon-Carbon Batteries: Realme P4 Power 5G, Motorola Signature and More

description: The Gujarat government on Monday signed a Letter of Intent with Starlink to work together on providing high-speed satellite internet across the state. The agreement, exchanged in Gandhinagar with SpaceX subsidiary Satellite Communications Private Limited, aims to connect remote, border, and underserved areas where telecom networks are weak, as part of Gujarat’s Digital Connectivity Mission and related strategic programmes initiatives.
title: Gujarat Exchanges Letter of Intent With Starlink for High-Speed Internet Connectivity

description: Huawei Pura X2 will be launched in China by the smartphone maker as the first wide folding handset, a tipster claims. The phone is said to be equipped with a 7.69-inch WQHD+ foldable display on the inside and a 5.5-inch cover display on the front. The handset will reportedly be powered by an “upgraded” Kirin 9030 chipset. It might also carry a telephoto camera on the back. For comparison, the Huawei Pura X was launched in China in March 2025. It is offered in Moon Shadow Gray, Magic Night Black, Stylish Red, Stylish Green, and Zero White colour options (translated from Chinese).
title: Huawei Pura X2 Tipped to Launch in China With 7.69-Inch Wide Folding Screen

description: The Infinix Note 60 Pro is confirmed to launch soon. It is teased to come in three colour options with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 5G chipset. It will offer a 1.5K resolution display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset will have a 50-megapixel Night Master Camera, a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging support. The Infinix Note 60 Pro will offer a 3D IceCore VC chamber cooling for thermal management.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Launch Teased; Design, Colourways, Key Specifications Revealed

description: NASA’s SPHEREx telescope has observed interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS unexpectedly brightening as it leaves the solar system. The comet released water vapour, carbon dioxide, and organic compounds months after its closest solar approach. Scientists say the findings provide a rare chemical snapshot of material formed around another star, helping compare planetary ingredients across the galaxy.
title: NASA’s SPHEREx Spots Interstellar Comet Flaring With Gas and Organic Molecules

description: Sony is set to unveil the WF-1000XM6 on February 12, but a new leak has revealed several expected upgrades. The earbuds are said to feature a quicker QN3e processor, eight adaptive microphones, and updated audio components including a new driver, DAC, and amplifier. Reported improvements also include enhanced ANC, a smarter Ambient Mode, LDAC, DSEE Extreme, and a 10-band equaliser. The leak further points to design tweaks, LE Audio, Auracast support, wireless charging, and up to 8 hours of claimed playback.
title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Key Features Leaked Ahead of February 12 Launch Event

description: Boat has launched the Chrome Iris smartwatch in India, starting at Rs. 3,499. It features an 8mm slim metal body and a 1.32-inch AMOLED display with 466x466 resolution and up to 1000 nits brightness. The watch includes Female Wellness Tracking, heart rate monitoring, SpO2 tracking, sleep analysis, guided breathing, and multiple sports modes. It supports Bluetooth calling, cloud-based watch faces, music controls, and utilities like weather and alarms. A 180mAh battery is claimed to offer up to five days of use.
title: Boat Chrome Iris Launched in India With 1.32-Inch AMOLED Display, Up to Five Days of Battery Life

description: Google Pixel 10a is confirmed to go on sale in India via Flipkart, as a dedicated microsite for the smartphone is now live on the e-commerce platform. The upcoming smartphone from the US-based tech giant is scheduled to be available for pre-order on February 18 via the Google India online store. The company recently confirmed the phone’s imminent arrival. However, Pixel 10a’s specifications, features, pricing, and exact launch date remain under wraps. The phone is teased to feature the same design as its predecessor, the Google Pixel 9a, which was launched in India in March 2025.
title: Google Pixel 10a Flipkart Availability Confirmed After Company Announces Pre-Orders Date: Expected Specifications

description: Itel A100 4G was launched in India on Monday. It arrives as the latest 4G handset from the Indian homegrown brand, sporting a design that closely resembles the OnePlus 13s. The company claims to offer military-grade durability on the handset, with MIL-STD-810H certification. The Itel A100 4G is powered by the UniSoc T7100 chipset, with up to 4GB of RAM. It has an 8-megapixel rear camera and packs a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Itel A100 4G Launched in India With 90Hz IPS Display, 5,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Anurag Kashyap’s Kennedy finally releases on OTT after its acclaimed Cannes premiere. Starring Rahul Bhat and Sunny Leone, the film is a dark, slow-burning crime drama that explores identity, guilt, and survival. Streaming exclusively on ZEE5 from February 20, 2026, Kennedy stands out as one of Kashyap’s most restrained and atmospheric works, with an IMDb rating of 6.4/10.
title: Kennedy OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch Sunny Leone Starrer Movie Online?

description: Unlike ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other major artificial intelligence (AI) platforms, Meta AI been relatively slow in shipping new features and products. However, a new report claims that the Mark Zuckerberg-owned tech giant is working on several major capabilities to improve the overall experience of the app. Two new AI models, integration of a browser agent, and support for OpenClaw were reportedly spotted in the code.
title: Meta AI Could Reportedly Get New ‘Avocado’ Models, AI Agents and OpenClaw Integration

description: Microsoft has not fully internally committed to a 2027 launch window for the next-gen Xbox, according to a report. The company reportedly considers next year as the "best case scenario"  for launching the next Xbox console. The Xbox parent is reportedly also working with OEMs to bring a range of Xbox hardware options across price points.
title: Microsoft Reportedly Not 'Fully Internally Committed' to Launching Next-Gen Xbox in 2027

description: Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro will be launched by the Carl Pei-led smartphone maker on March 5, according to a report. Recently, the Phone 4a was spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and the UAE’s Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) websites. Now, the Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro, with the A069 and A069P model numbers, have been listed on the European Economic Community (EEC) certification database, reiterating their imminent arrival.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Series Launch Teased as Handsets Receive EEC Certification: Expected Price, Features

description: Oppo Find N6 will be launched in China and select countries in South Asia and Europe on March 17, according to a tipster. The smartphone is said to be offered in Titanium and Orange colour options. This comes soon after Oppo Product Manager Zhou Yibao teased the launch of a new foldable smartphone. The upcoming handset will reportedly feature a 200-megapixel camera on the back, housed inside a thin and light form factor. It might ship with AI Pen support, too. However, the phone will not be launched in India, the tipster claims.
title: Oppo Find N6 Launch Date and Colourways Leaked as Company Executive Teases Upcoming China Debut

description: Perplexity introduced a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature last week that is designed to provide more accurate and comprehensive answers to users. Dubbed Model Council, the new mode in the platform lets users run the same query across three different AI models. The platform then compares the answers and shares a list of insights that users can skim through quickly to understand the headline information, as well as quickly verify the response.
title: Perplexity’s New Feature Compares Answers From Three Different AI Models

description: Poco is expected to launch the Poco X8 series globally in March. The lineup is said to include the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max. The Poco X8 Pro has reportedly appeared on South Korea’s RRA certification database with model number 2511FPC34G. It is expected to be powered by MediaTek’s Dimensity 8500 chipset and feature an IP68-rated design for dust and water resistance.
title: Poco X8 Pro Launch Seems Imminent as Smartphone Reportedly Bags RRA Certification in South Korea

description: Oppo is reportedly conducting widespread layoffs in Realme’s India division. As per the report, the Chinese brand is absorbing Realme India’s sales and support teams in an effort to consolidate the divisions and lower the overall business costs. The reported development comes just a month after Realme agreed to rejoin Oppo as its sub-brand.
title: Realme Reportedly Cutting Jobs in India: Oppo’s Consolidation Explained

description: Redmi K100 series leaks suggest major camera upgrades, including a possible 200-megapixel sensor and periscope telephoto lens. A tipster links the rumour to the upcoming K100 lineup, expected to include the Redmi K100 and K100 Pro Max. The 200-megapixel camera may debut on the Pro Max model, though its placement remains unclear. The K100 Pro Max could launch globally as the Poco F9 Ultra. Both phones are tipped to feature flagship Snapdragon processors.
title: Redmi K100 Series Camera Details Leaked; K100 Pro Max Variant Said to Launch Globally as Poco F9 Ultra

description: Telegram has released a major update for its Android app, introducing a refreshed design based on the Liquid Glass styling. It brings new translucent panels and a new four-tab bottom navigation bar, resembling the design of the iOS version. The bottom bar houses the Chats, Contacts, Settings, and Profile options, and it remains visible when we scroll through each section. Telegram has also placed the New Group menu inside the three-dot overflow menu in the top-right corner of the chats screen.
title: Telegram App for Android Gets Liquid Glass-Inspired Redesign With Bottom Navigation Bar

description: Jiiva’s Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil is set for its OTT debut on Netflix from February 12, 2026. After a successful theatrical run, the political satire-comedy arrives on streaming with strong audience goodwill. Directed by Nithish Sahadev, the film combines clean humour, village politics, and engaging characters, earning an IMDb rating of 7.6/10 and positioning itself as a perfect family watch on OTT.
title: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: The Roughneck is a thriller drama film that stars Austin North in the lead role. The film will stream on Lionsgate Play.
title: The Roughneck OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Thriller Film Online?

description: The Xiaomi 17 series was launched in China in September 2025, comprising the standard, Pro, and Pro Max models. Leaks about its purported successor have already begun surfacing. According to a tipster, the company could introduce notable camera upgrades with the Xiaomi 18 Pro. The China-based OEM is tipped to be testing dual 200-megapixel cameras for a compact 6.3-inch flagship, which is believed to be the aforementioned Xiaomi handset.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Leak Hints at Presence of Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras, Just like Oppo Find X10 Pro

description: Apple is expected to release iOS 26.4 in the coming weeks, bringing the first wave of delayed Siri and Apple Intelligence upgrades. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says the developer beta could arrive during the week of February 23, followed by a public beta in late February or early March, with a final rollout expected by end of March. Reported features include personal context, on-screen awareness, and expanded in-app controls. The update may also add new emojis.
title: Apple's First iOS 26.4 Beta Said to Release Later This Month With Siri Updates

description: Jack Dorsey’s Block (formerly Square) is reportedly planning a large-scale layoff in the coming days. As per the report, the financial services tech platform might cut down as much as 10 percent of its workforce, as part of its upcoming annual performance reviews. The company reportedly has just shy of 11,000 employees, which means the potential layoffs can affect hundreds of workers.
title: Jack Dorsey’s Block Is Reportedly Planning to Lay Off Hundreds of Employees

description: MacBook Pro with Apple's M5 Pro and M5 Max chipsets are said to be in the works. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman states that an Apple product launch is slated for as early as the week of March 2. New MacBook Pro with Apple's M5 Pro and M5 Max chipsets could launch during this event. Upgraded Mac Studio desktops, a low-cost MacBook model and  14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros and the MacBook Air with an M5 processor could also launch soon.
title: Apple's MacBook Pro With M5 Pro, M5 Max Chips Said to Launch Soon; Various Mac Models Expected in 2026

description: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G has been launched in India by the South Korean handset maker. The new smartphone, which will go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Samsung India online store, is offered in Limelite Green and Spotlight Blue colour options. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset powers the handset. The South Korean tech giant claims that the new Galaxy SF70e 5G managed to score about 6,23,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. It is backed by a 6,000mAh battery, too. The phone carries a dual rear camera unit.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Features

description: The iPhone 18 series has been rumoured to mark a shift in Apple’s product lineup, with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max expected to launch in September, while the vanilla iPhone 18 debuts in 2027. According to a tipster, the Cupertino-based tech giant is testing two major camera improvements for the next-generation iPhones, including a variable aperture for improved imaging. The iPhone 18 Pro models are also tipped to benefit from an upgraded telephoto camera.
title: Apple Testing Variable Aperture Lens, Upgraded Telephoto Camera for iPhone 18 Pro Models, Tipster Claims

description: Epic Games Store boss Steve Allison has said that the company was planning for its digital games marketplace to be on the next-gen Xbox home console at launch. In an interview last week, Allison said that Epic Games Store will be on the next Xbox "on day one".
title: Epic Games Says It Plans for Its Store to Be on Next-Gen Xbox 'On Day One'

description: Apple will launch the refreshed standard iPad, iPad Mini, and iPad Mini models, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman claimed in his latest Power On newsletter. He said thatt said that this year’s iPad models will not ship with design changes or other significant upgrades. However, they will reportedly be powered by faster chipsets. While the standard model is said to ship with Apple’s A18 chip, the iPad Mini could be upgraded to the M4 chipset. However, the Cupertino company has yet to confirm the launches of the new models.
title: Apple Said to Launch New iPad Models Soon With Upgraded Chips, Familiar Design

description: Google’s popular artificial intelligence (AI)-powered research and note-taking platform, NotebookLM, received a new feature recently. The feature is for the mobile app, and now allows users to customise infographics and slide decks directly via their smartphones. Several aspects of the output can be changed, including length, orientation, language, and style.
title: Google’s NotebookLM App Will Now Let You Customise Infographics and Slide Decks

description: YouTube Music seems to have limited access to lyrics for free users. Once the free limit is used up, the lyrics section displays the first few lines. A bar appears above the lyrics section showing how many free views remain for users, along with an option to upgrade to Premium. This move could be aimed at encouraging more users to sign up for a Premium subscription. The platform's major rival, Spotify, currently offers lyrics for its unpaid users.
title: YouTube Music Reportedly Adds Paywall to Limit Lyrics Access for Some Users

description: Motorola may soon launch the Moto Buds 2 Plus, according to leaked renders shared by a tipster. The images show stem-style earbuds inside a redesigned oval charging case with “Sound by Bose” branding. Unlike the Moto Buds+, which used a horizontal layout, the new model appears to store earbuds vertically. Two colour options are visible: white with a pale blue interior and dark blue with a blue-grey lining. Motorola has not confirmed specifications, pricing, or launch details.
title: Motorola's Moto Buds 2 Plus Leaked Renders Reveal Updated Case Design, Colourways and Bose Partnership

description: The Oppo K14x 5G is scheduled to go official in India tomorrow (February 10), and there are indications that it could be joined by another handset soon. Another model in the Oppo K14 Series 5G has been listed on a certification website, revealing its moniker. While the China-based company has yet to confirm its plans to launch another model in the K14 lineup, the listing on the database indicates that its introduction may not be too far away.
title: Oppo K14 5G Listed on Bluetooth SIG Certification Site As Oppo K14x 5G India Launch Nears

description: Apple has widely been rumoured to kick off the launch of its 2026 hardware lineup with the introduction of the iPhone 17e. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to announce the handset, the rumour mill has suggested what it could offer in terms of specifications. According to a seasoned journalist, the successor to the iPhone 16e will pack three key upgrades, including a more powerful chipset and a new networking chip.
title: iPhone 17e Reportedly Set for Chipset and Wireless Charging Upgrades; No Price Hike Expected
